title: #sweeneytodd
transcript: everyone's talking about this and I'm gonna talk about it too sweeney todd is my favorite show I know it's a lot of people's favorite shows it's one of those shows that the first time you hear the score you're like oh this is what musical theater can be it can also be this you know I'm not gonna explain ST — you get it if you get it you get it but the thing is with a show like that people are really passionate about what the show needs to be what it needs to look like a lot of expectations around the show additionally I've seen different productions of sweeney todd than I have any other show I made a little list here and I've seen 12 different productions of sweeney todd over my lifetime I'm probably forgetting a few and I was in a production of sweeney todd myself someone asked me a few years ago if there was a revival of sweeney todd what would you want it to look like on broadway and my answer was basically what this production sounds like it's going to be — a full scale production with a full orchestra so I'm so glad we're getting a 26 piece orchestra also many of those regional productions of sweeney todd had really sizeable orchestras so support your regional theatre if you want to hear full orchestra and josh groban I think he'll surprise us I think he will
classificationReason: Creator discusses Sweeney Todd productions generally and anticipation for an upcoming revival, but no specific production from the list is being reviewed. This is commentary about the show concept and expectations.
